key_insight: Machine-learning analysis identified three PsA-specific synovial tissue patterns: Dense Myeloid, Fibro-Stromal, and Angio-Lymphoid.
clinical_relevance: These tissue patterns could support future precision-medicine research, but their ability to guide treatment remains unvalidated.
method: Analyzed ultrasound-guided synovial biopsies using multi-modal staining and digital whole-slide imaging.
Used automated pixel classifiers to quantify cellular and stromal features.
Applied unsupervised hierarchical clustering to identify PsA pathotypes and explore clinical associations.
evidence_signal: Among 61 participants, including 22 with PsA, exploratory treatment-response rates were 44% for Fibro-Stromal, 50% for Dense Myeloid, and 80% for Angio-Lymphoid.
watch_item: The small PsA cohort and exploratory response trends require independent prospective validation before clinical use.
paper_title: Redefining Synovial Pathotypes in Psoriatic Arthritis through Multi-Modal Histology and Machine Learning (The PSYNOVIUM Study)
